violation_type.title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge
violation_type.typical_finding: Staff at the operation did not have a person in charge. The staff that assisted me at the operation were front desk staff who did not have access to conduct important task.

finding_variants.text: Staff at the operation did not have a person in charge. The staff that assisted me at the operation were front desk staff who did not have access to conduct important task.
The operation failed to notify Licensing of the director's extended absence or who the designated person in charge would be during the absence.
The director or person in charge was not available. A designated individual was not assigned in the absence of the person in charge. The director arrived during the inspection.
There was no one designated to be in charge of the operation during the director's absence.
Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, at the time of the operation visit on 06/20/2025, CCI observed that no designated person in charge was present at the center.
There was no one in charged at the center during the absence of the director  while she was on a fieldtrip.

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: There was no staff in charge of the operation while the director was not present.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Upon my arrival at the operation at 7:55 am. There were three caregivers and children present, but no one oversaw the operation or was put in charge while the director was not present at the operation. The administrative director arrived at 8:33 am and stated they oversaw the operation and was in charge when the director was not present.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Staff did not know who was in charge of the operation at arrival on 8/13/26.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Upon arrival at 11:25AM, no one was able to answer the door and allowed CCR entry until the director arrived at 12:20PM. No qualified caregiver was left in charge are able to answer the door without supervision concerns.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Evidence obtained during a DFPS investigation revealed that a qualified person was not left in charge during the director?s recent absence.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The director was not present at the center and there was no one left in charged of the center duirng the director's absence.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The director or person in charge was not available. A designated individual was not assigned in the absence of the person in charge. The director arrived during the inspection.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The operation failed to notify Licensing of the director's extended absence or who the designated person in charge would be during the absence.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: There was no one designated to be in charge of the operation during the director's absence.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Based on the information gathered, the person in charge was not qualified to make the decisions necessary in the event of an emergency.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: During an inspection on 12/11/25, the director was not present. A caregiver was asked if there was anyone in charge and there was not.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Director is not present at the operation, and none of the operation staff were informed who was in charge.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The director or person in charge was not available during the inspection. A designated individual was not assigned in the absence of the person in charge.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Director left unqualified caregiver in charge of center.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Upon arrival, there was no designated qualified caregiver present at the operation in the director's absence.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The caregiver in charge came in 30 minutes into the operation.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: During the follow-up inspection I asked the two caregivers present who was in charge when the director is not present and both caregivers did not know that someone has to be in charge when the director is not present. Both caregivers stated I get here when there's already children, how can i be in charge.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: There was no caregiver left in charge during the director's absence.         Note: This was corrected when the director arrived at the operation.
Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The director did not have a caregiver listed as next in charge in her absence.

Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: The caregiver in charge in the director's absence did not have access to field trip information requested by Child Care Regulation. The caregiver also could not access the keys to the vehicles used for transportation during the visit.
